One site, two skins
The Android app is a Capacitor W
eb
View shell that loads the same
dishswapp.pgmja.com pages as every browser visitor
. "
App mode" is a render
variant of those pages — nothing about the content, data, or auth changes.
The shell's W
eb
View announces itself in its user agent (
; wv)
). The site reads that
header once per request and renders the page with
html.app-mode
, which switches
on the app skin: a compact teal header
, a fixed bottom tab bar
, no web footer
, and
Android-appropriate touch behavior
. Every browser — desktop and phone — sees
the current website, pixel for pixel.
THE APP GETS
WHAT NEVER CHANGES
Compact app header (wordmark +
account) replacing the hamburger navbar
All pages, routes, and content
Fixed 5-tab bottom bar — Home · Search ·
Submit · Cookbook · Profile
Clerk authentication and Google sign-in
flow
Flow screens with a back
-arrow app bar
and sticky action button
Supabase data, recipe APIs, admin tools
Fo
oter hidden; About · Donate move onto
the Home screen
SEO
, OG tags, PW
A manifest
Native touch: no pull-to-refresh, no tap
flash, safe-area spacing
We
bsite layout at every breakpoint

This spec covers the app-mode
skin
only
. It inherits every token, type rule, and
voice decision from

Why the fonts don't change
Android apps ship with Roboto by default, but DishSwapp's identity is Playfair +
Inter
. The W
eb
View already loads both via Google F
onts, and Inter's metrics sit
close enough to Roboto that system text (paste sheets, autofill) won't clash. K
eep
the brand faces.
Fixed labels under tab icons
—
Material bottom navigation, not an
iOS tab bar
, not a drawer
.
